payload.summary: Warlock levitates weapon and throws projections that travel out and return, dealing physical+magic damage on both paths. FCR governs attack rate (75% FCR breakpoint required). Considered strongest Warlock build in S13; nerfs in patch 3.2 made synergy additive instead of multiplicative.
